washtub.prompt: A wooden washtub of staves bound with two iron hoops, grey water in it, a wooden ribbed washboard standing in it leaning to one side, a cloth over the rim; three-quarter north-up view, at the scale of the person kneeling at it; warm hand-drawn storybook style, dark olive-brown outline, flat shade, transparent ground, no shadow.
